title: Add an asset
body: Snap an invoice or pick from the catalogue. DocsBuddy fills in the brand, model and details for you.

title: Set due dates
body: Insurance, AMC, pollution, warranty, tax, fitness — add the dates that matter and how often they repeat.

title: Get nudged
body: Sit back. DocsBuddy reminds you and your family well ahead — and again as the deadline closes in.
